meta.title: One Workspace, One Cargo.lock, One Build

cards.title: One shared build
items: Both crates share one Cargo.lock and one target/ directory
cargo build -p billing-domain compiles only that crate and its dependencies

cards.title: Thin binary, real library
items: main.rs just wires things together and calls into billing-domain
Domain logic is testable without spinning up the binary at all
